name: Acid Splash
description: You create a bubble of acid and hurl it at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On hit, the target takes 1d6 Acid damage. This spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach certain levels (2d6 at 5th, 3d6 at 11th, 4d6 at 17th).

name: Dancing Lights
description: You create up to four torch-sized lights within range. Each light sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius. You can move the lights up to 60 feet as a Bonus Action. The lights last until you dismiss them as an action or cast this spell again.

name: Fire Bolt
description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites unless it is being worn or carried. Damage increases by 1d10 at higher levels (2d10 at 5th, 3d10 at 11th, 4d10 at 17th).

name: Guidance
description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. The spell then ends.

name: Light
description: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like. Completely covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.

name: Mage Hand
description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you cast this spell again. You can use your action to control the hand. The hand can manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial. The hand can move up to 30 feet each time you use it.

name: Mending
description: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch. As long as the break or tear is no larger than 1 foot in any dimension, you can mend it. This spell can physically repair a magic item, but it can't restore magic to such an object.

name: Message
description: You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target hears the message in its mind. You can reply in a whisper that can be heard only by the target. The spell empowers the sender with magical favor. The next attack roll made against the target before the end of the sender's next turn has advantage.

name: Minor Illusion
description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a drumming, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration. If you create an image of an object (such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest), it must be no larger than a 5-foot cube.

name: Poison Spray
description: You spray toxic vapor in a 10-foot cone. Each creature in that cone must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d12 Poison damage. Damage increases by 1d12 at higher levels (2d12 at 5th, 3d12 at 11th, 4d12 at 17th).

name: Produce Flame
description: A flickering flame appears in your hand and lasts for the duration. The flame doesn't harm you or your equipment. Until the spell ends, you can use a Bonus Action to hurl fire at a creature or object within 30 feet. Make a ranged spell attack. On hit, the target takes 1d8 Fire damage. Damage increases by 1d8 at higher levels (2d8 at 5th, 3d8 at 11th, 4d8 at 17th).

name: Ray of Frost
description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On hit, the target takes 1d8 Cold damage and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. Damage increases by 1d8 at higher levels (2d8 at 5th, 3d8 at 11th, 4d8 at 17th).

name: Resistance
description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice. The spell then ends.

name: Sacred Flame
description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 Radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw. Damage increases by 1d8 at higher levels (2d8 at 5th, 3d8 at 11th, 4d8 at 17th).

name: Spare the Dying
description: You touch a living creature that has 0 Hit Points. The creature becomes Stable.

name: Thaumaturgy
description: You manifest a minor wonder within range. You create one of the following effects: - Your voice booms up to three times louder than normal. - You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color. - You cause harmless tremors in the ground. - You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut. - You alter the appearance of your eyes.

name: True Strike
description: You point a finger at a target within range. Your magic grants you a brief insight into the target's defenses. On your next turn, you gain Advantage on one attack roll against the target, provided the attack is before the end of your next turn.

name: Bless
description: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to the roll.

name: Burning Hands
description: As you hold your hands with thumbs touching and fingers spread, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outspread fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot above 1st.

name: Charm Person
description: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. If you and the target aren't hostile toward each other, the target has Advantage on the saving throw. If it fails the save, it is Charmed by you until the spell ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. The Charmed creature regards you as a friendly acquaintance.

name: Color Spray
description: You launch a burst of colorful light. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become Blinded until the end of your next turn.

name: Command
description: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. The command must be brief: Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, Halt.

name: Cure Wounds
description: A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting Ability modifier. This spell has no effect on constructs or undead. Healing increases by 1d8 for each spell slot above 1st.

name: Detect Magic
description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of yourself. You also learn the school of magic associated with any magical effect you see. The spell can penetrate most barriers, but is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

name: Disguise Self
description: You make yourself—including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings—look different. You can appear 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear heavy or thin. You must adopt the same basic arrangement of limbs. The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection.

name: Divine Favor
description: Until the spell ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage.

name: Ensnaring Strike
description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be Restrained by a magical plant. A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself and the plants end.

name: Entangle
description: Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into difficult terrain. A creature in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be Restrained by the plants until the spell ends.

name: Expeditious Retreat
description: Until the spell ends, your Speed increases by 10 feet.

name: Faerie Fire
description: Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Any creature in the area when the spell is cast is also outlined in light if it fails a Dexterity saving throw; a creature that succeeeds on the save isn't affected. Outlined creatures and objects can be easily seen even in darkness or when seen through magical darkness.

name: False Life
description: You gain 2d4 + 4 Temporary Hit Points. Temporary Hit Points increase by 5 for each spell slot above 1st.

name: Feather Fall
description: When you or a creature within 60 feet of you falls, you can use your reaction to cast this spell. Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If the creature lands before the spell ends, it takes no falling damage and can land on its feet.

name: Find Familiar
description: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose. The familiar has the statistics of the chosen form, but is a Celestial, Fey, or Fiend (your choice) instead of a Beast. Your familiar acts independently and can deliver spells with a range of touch.

name: Fog Cloud
description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is Heavily Obscured. The fog moves away from you at 10 feet per round.

name: Goodberry
description: Up to ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic. A creature can use its action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 Hit Point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day. The berries lose their potency if not consumed within 24 hours.

name: Grease
description: Slick grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square within range. The grease makes the ground in the area Difficult Terrain. When the grease appears, each creature standing in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

name: Guiding Bolt
description: You hurl a bolt of light toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On hit, the target takes 4d6 Radiant damage and the next attack roll made against it before the end of your next turn has Advantage. Damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot above 1st.

name: Healing Word
description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains Hit Points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting Ability modifier. This spell has no effect on constructs or undead. Healing increases by 1d4 for each spell slot above 1st.

name: Heroism
description: A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery. Until the spell ends, the creature is immune to the Frightened condition and gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your spellcasting Ability modifier at the start of each of its turns. When the spell ends, the target loses any remaining Temporary Hit Points.

name: Hideous Laughter
description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range begins to cackle uncontrollably. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Prone and Incapacitated conditions for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

name: Hunter's Mark
description: You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry. Until the spell ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 damage to the target. If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before this spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action to move the mark to a new creature you can see within range.

name: Identify

components.M: a pearl worth at least 100 gp

description: You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting of the spell. If the object is a magic item or some other magic-imbued object, you learn its properties and how to use them. You also learn the number of charges it has, if any.

name: Inflict Wounds
description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On hit, the target takes 3d10 Necrotic damage. Damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot above 1st.

name: Jump
description: The target's jump distance is tripled until the spell ends.

name: Longstrider
description: The target's Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

name: Magic Missile
description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart targets a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4+1 Force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the number of darts increases by two for each slot level above 1st.

name: Protection from Evil and Good

components.M: holy water or powdered silver and iron

description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against certain types of creatures: Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead. The protection grants several benefits.

name: Shield
description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you are immune to Magic Missile.

name: Silent Image
description: You create a visual illusion of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon within range. The illusion is purely visual; it isn't accompanied by sound, smell, or other sensory effects.

name: Sleep
description: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber. Roll 5d8. The total is how many Hit Points of creatures this spell can affect. Creatures within 20 feet of a point you choose within range are affected in ascending order of their current Hit Points.
